testcase.name: Transport rejects invalid timer configuration and socket factory IO failure is typed()
Disconnect interrupts and joins a pending connect without invoking the loss handler()
Connection deadline includes interruptible address resolution()
Cancelling an active write closes the socket propagates cancellation and fails queued writes()
Cancelling a queued write does not close the live connection or send its bytes()
Cancelling an interruptible resolver closes the socket and never starts a late connect()
Disconnect drains blocked write and read jobs before returning()
Whole write operation remains serialized while the first write is suspended()
Connect failure exposes reason cause and any cleanup failure without fake success()
Connection timeout is exactly ten seconds and closes and joins blocked IO()
Write timeout is exactly five seconds terminates the generation and notifies once()
New connection waits for old connect cleanup and uses only its fresh real socket()
Close failure is surfaced to disconnect and stream instead of being silently discarded()
Send failure preserves reason and cause and closes the established generation()
Read failure preserves the original IO cause in both stream and handler()
Queued connect requests from before disconnect cannot reopen the connection()
Cancelling pending connect does not leave it parked or leak its socket()
Late old-generation send failure cannot close or notify the new real generation()
Native socket timeout keeps typed timeout and original cause()
Cancelling only the consumer does not close the live socket and next raw packet remains available()
